titulo: Why people don't trust a business without a website
hooks: Why do people ask for photos before buying?
Can't find you? They won't trust you
Customers doubt you before they meet you
voz: Before buying from you, people look for signs that you're real. They check for actual photos of your place, customer reviews, an address and a clear way to reach you. A polished website puts all of that in one place. Without it, even if you're the best, you look like everyone else.
captions: Before paying someone they don't know, your customer looks for proof: real photos, reviews, an address. If they don't find it, they hesitate, even if you're the best in town.
A polished website shows your work, tells people who you are and makes it clear how to reach you, any time, without you having to explain it.
Stock photos are easy to spot. Photos of your place, your team and your real work show your customer that you actually exist.
